meta.product: Tasks queued in releng-hardware/gecko-t-linux-talos-2404 (perf tasks), 2026-11-18 10:00:00 UTC to 2026-11-18 13:00:00 UTC

markerSchema.name: QueueBin
markerSchema.description: The mean number of tasks of this priority and kind waiting for a worker in the queue during these 5 minutes. It is a count: the individual tasks are not known.

markerSchema.name: QueueTask
markerSchema.description: A task waiting for a worker in the queue: from when it was scheduled until a worker claimed it, or until it left unclaimed.

markerSchema.name: QueueStack
markerSchema.description: All the tasks waiting for a worker in the queue during these 5 minutes, stacked from the first in line, by priority and kind. The mean number of each.

markerSchema.name: PoolWorkers
markerSchema.description: The workers of the pool during these 15 minutes. The pool has no configured size here: it is the number of workers that ran something in a session overlapping them, where a session ends after 24 hours without a run. Busy is the mean number of them running a task or starting the next.
